objective: Independent physical certification postcheck after R8 controlled commit deployment. Read only. Confirm canonical SQL identity and exactly 4/4 RRR Customer360 views persisted. No DDL, no DML, no repository changes, no Production.

sql_checks.name: r8_independent_identity
sql_checks.query: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name

sql_checks.name: r8_independent_present_count
sql_checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present_count FROM sys.views WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360')

sql_checks.name: r8_independent_present_names
sql_checks.query: SELECT name AS view_name FROM sys.views WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360') ORDER BY name

sql_checks.name: r8_independent_duplicate_customer360
sql_checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_groups FROM (SELECT ClienteID FROM dbo.vw_RRR_Customer360 GROUP BY ClienteID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) d
